text:
Maria Chen: hey devex — new hire @Leo Park started this morning. Can someone help get him access to Redwood Console staging and prod admin panels? He also needs feature-flag editor rights for his team. Who do I ping and what's the process?

Devex Bot: Welcome Leo Park! Please follow the access onboarding checklist here: https://intranet.redwood/ops/access. If you need expedited access, mention @devex and @eng-platform.

Alex Johnson: Hi Maria — standard flow: (1) Submit an Access Request in the Access Portal (link above) with manager approval, (2) Eng Platform will add them to Okta groups: "Redwood-Console-Staging-Editor" and optionally "Redwood-Console-Prod-ReadOnly" or "Redwood-Console-Prod-Admin" (prod admin needs Security sign-off), (3) For feature flags, ask me or the FF owner to add the user to the appropriate environment/team. Expect 1-2 business days for prod if security approval is required.

Maria Chen: Thanks Alex. Can we do staging-only for this week? He needs to validate flows before getting prod.

Alex Johnson: Yes — we can grant staging-only immediately once you file the access request and the manager approves. Use the role: "Redwood-Console-Staging-Editor".

Maria Chen: @Sam Ortiz — can you handle the Okta group add once I file the request? Leo's email is leo.park@redwood.com and employee id 48291.

Sam Ortiz: Yep, pinged. I can add to staging now. I'll need the Access Request ID for recordkeeping — otherwise I can do a short-lived grant and we can reconcile. Which do you prefer?

Maria Chen: Short-lived grant is fine for now (1 week). I'll still file the portal request ASAP.

Sam Ortiz: Done — added leo.park@redwood.com to "Redwood-Console-Staging-Editor" for 7 days. @Devex Bot please close with note.

Devex Bot: Access change logged: user leo.park@redwood.com added to Redwood-Console-Staging-Editor by Sam Ortiz. Expires in 7 days. Ticket: AR-2026-114.

Leo Park: Thanks everyone! I can see the staging console. Quick Q — where do I find the feature-flag editor UI? (I only see the feature flags summary page.)

Alex Johnson: In the console sidebar: Settings > Feature Flags > Environments. If you don't see 'Edit' buttons, ping me and I'll add the 'Feature-Flags-Editor' role. Also check that your org/team mapping is set in the FF platform.

Leo Park: I see it now. Able to toggle staging flags. Will wait for prod access later. Thanks :thumbsup: 

Maria Chen: Awesome — tagging this thread in the new-hire onboarding doc. Thanks everyone for the quick turnaround :partyparrot:
